## PTT-COPIER-B18 Deferred Work

### DW-B17-SYNC-01 — Copy ON/OFF sync (P2)

**Status**: DEFERRED to B19
**Blocked by**: PTT-COPIER-B17 must close and merge first (owns TradeCopierPanel.cs)
**Files**: `CopyEngine.cs`, `TradeCopierPanel.cs`, `TradeCopierWindow.cs`

**Description**: Copy ON/OFF state shown in TradeCopierPanel (`_copyEnabled`) and
TradeCopierWindow (`_copyEnabled`) are completely independent. Toggling one surface does
NOT update the other. Same defect applies to Signal/Mirror mode.

**Fix design**:
1. Add `internal event Action<bool> CopyEnabledChanged` to `CopyEngine`.
2. Fire it at end of `SetEnabled(bool)`.
3. Both Panel and Window subscribe on Loaded, unsubscribe on Detach/Closed.
4. Handler updates `_copyEnabled` and button label/background via `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync`.
5. Same pattern for `SetCopyMode()` → `CopyModeChanged event Action<CopyMode>`.

### DW-B17-ACCOUNT-NAME-01 — Strip !Apex!Apex broker suffix (P2)

**Status**: DEFERRED to B19
**Files**: `TradeCopierWindow.cs`

**Description**: Account names display as `"PA-APEX-422136-02!Apex!Apex"` instead of
`"PA-APEX-422136-02"`. The `!Apex!Apex` suffix is the broker/connection identifier
appended to `Account.Name` by NT8 for real funded accounts. Strip at display layer only:
`acc.Name.Split('!')[0]`. Keep raw `acc.Name` for all engine dictionary keys to avoid
ATM template lookup mismatches.

### NT8 WPF Scrollbar Discovery — Knowledge Base Entry

**Block confirmed**: B18 (T2b follow-up fix by Director)

NT8 WPF host suppresses the ListBox internal scrollbar even when the content overflows
the fixed height — WPF virtualization still generates only N containers for the available
clip rect unless virtualization is explicitly disabled.

**Confirmed fix pattern (B18 T2b)**:
```csharp
VirtualizingStackPanel.SetIsVirtualizing(listBox, false);
ScrollViewer.SetVerticalScrollBarVisibility(listBox, ScrollBarVisibility.Visible);
listBox.Height = 100;   // fixed height (not MaxHeight)
// Do NOT wrap the ListBox in an outer ScrollViewer
```

**Why both calls are needed**:
- `SetIsVirtualizing(false)` forces WPF to render ALL item containers immediately,
  bypassing the virtualized clip-rect container generation.
- `SetVerticalScrollBarVisibility(Visible)` ensures the internal ScrollViewer's scrollbar
  is always shown even when WPF calculates ScrollableHeight = 0 due to container reuse.
- Both must be set; either alone may not produce a scrollbar in NT8's WPF host.

**Apply to any ListBox in NT8 WPF windows that requires scrolling.**
